shapeSummary: Planetary gearbox with its axis along Y, bottom at Y=0. A Ø36 x 21.1 mm body is followed by a 24x24 mm, 11.6 mm tall front housing and an 8 mm REX shaft with 7 mm flats that projects 23.5 mm. Total length is 56.2 mm. The front face has four 4 mm holes, 10 mm deep, at (±8, ±8). The rear face has four Ø3 holes on a 25 mm pattern at 45° and a Ø13 central recess.
warnings: Front housing is modeled as a plain 24x24 square block. The real housing has clearance cuts and a stepped profile that are not modeled.
The (0,±12) M4 holes (6 mm deep) are omitted because they would break out of the simplified 24 mm housing.
Threads are not modeled. The M4 holes are drawn as plain 4 mm holes.
Depths of the rear Ø3 holes (6 mm) and the Ø13 recess (5 mm) are not stated and were assumed.
The vendor's 24 mm length conflicts with the 32.7 mm body length in the drawing. The drawing was used.
The rear Ø3 hole angles (45°) are assumed from the view.
The central hex nut and shaft-end details are omitted.

def cyl(d,h,y0,pts=[(0,0)]):
    return cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,y0,0)).pushPoints(pts).circle(d/2).extrude(-h)

body=cyl(36,21.1,0)
housing=cq.Workplane('XZ',origin=(0,21.1,0)).rect(24,24).extrude(-11.6)
shaft=cyl(8,23.5,32.7).intersect(cq.Workplane('XY').box(7,200,10,centered=(True,True,True)))
part=body.union(housing).union(shaft)

front=[(-8,-8),(8,-8),(-8,8),(8,8)]
part=part.cut(cyl(4,10,32.7-10,front))
rear=[(8.84,8.84),(-8.84,8.84),(8.84,-8.84),(-8.84,-8.84)]
part=part.cut(cyl(3,6,0,rear))
part=part.cut(cyl(13,5,0))
